question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Step up to the plate
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'Take control of a situation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To **"step up to the plate": **To take responsibility or take action in a challenging situation (कठिन परिस्थिति में जिम्मेदारी लेना या कार्रवाई करना)

 
 
• **Example**: When the team leader fell ill, Anita stepped up to the plate and ensured the project was completed on time.
 
 
 
• **Take control of a situation:** (किसी स्थिति का नियंत्रण लेना)
 
• This option 4 directly reflects the idiom's meaning related to taking responsibility and action, especially when it is needed or when facing challenges.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Take control of a situation'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Think about a crisis:** This does not capture the proactive, responsibility-taking nature of the idiom.
 
• **Plan for better performance:** This focuses on preparation, not the comprehensive action or taking charge implied by the idiom.
 
• **Implement a plan:** While part of taking control, the idiom more broadly signifies seizing initiative or responsibility, which goes beyond mere implementation.
